title: Period-state accumulation declares initial and terminal observation inclusion
question: Compare beginning-of-period survival states, complete prefix paths, storage type, empty inputs and the effect of the last observation; do not equate generic scans with cash-flow valuation.

evidence.title: Offset accumulation keeps initial state but drops final observation effect
explanation: accum_offset produces same-length output: firstinit and subsequentprefixes ending at x[n-1]. This fits a beginning-of-period survival-state convention, not an n+1path including final survival. Storage inherits input element type and empty input lacks a guard.
Injected op can mean multiplication/addition/custom behavior; no probability range enforced. Static counterexamples, not executed, and no mortality model acceptance.
